title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
summary: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.
content: During a regulatory commission nomination process, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland raised questions regarding the public benefit of prediction markets amid ongoing legal challenges. Rowland expressed a desire to have a direct role in shaping future rulemaking related to these prediction platforms as legal debates continue to grow across the industry.
content_ta: ஒழுங்குமுறை ஆணையத்துக்கான நியமனத்தின் போது, Democratic nominee-ரான Matthew Rowland, prediction markets-ன் பொது நலன் குறித்து கேள்வி எழுப்பியுள்ளார். இந்தத் துறை தொடர்பான சட்டப் போராட்டம் அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், prediction markets விதிகளுக்கு வடிவம் கொடுப்பதில் தனக்கு முக்கிய பங்கு இருக்கும் என்று அவர் நம்பிக்கை தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
summary: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.
content: Nvidia reported a record $116B quarter, beating Wall Street revenue expectations by 5.6% and issuing a strong sales forecast. Despite the massive financial success, the Nvidia board rejected growing calls for Jensen Huang to make a comeback.
content_ta: Nvidia நிறுவனமானது சாதனை அளவிலான $116B வருவாய் ஈட்டியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. Wall Street எதிர்பார்ப்புகளை 5.6% தாண்டி புதிய சாதனை படைத்துள்ள போதிலும், Jensen Huang மீண்டும் தலைமை பதவிக்கு வருவதற்கான கோரிக்கைகளை Nvidia வாரியம் நிராகரித்துள்ளது.

title: Researchers train AI in simulation and unlock real robot skills
summary:
PEAR researchers report transfer of pickup and block-alignment skills to different hardware, with long reasoning delays limiting use.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Researchers have successfully trained artificial intelligence models within simulations and transferred those skills to real-world robotic hardware. According to reports from PEAR, the robots acquired pickup and block-alignment capabilities. However, researchers noted that significant reasoning delays currently limit the practical deployment of these newly acquired robotic skills in live environments.
content_ta: சிமுலேஷன் மூலம் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு தொழில்நுட்பத்தை பயிற்சி செய்து, அதனை நிஜ உலக ரோபோக்களுக்கு வெற்றிகரமாக மாற்றியுள்ளனர் ஆய்வாளர்கள். PEAR வெளியிட்டுள்ள தகவலின்படி, இந்த ரோபோக்கள் பொருட்களை எடுப்பது மற்றும் தொகுதிகளை சீரமைப்பது போன்ற திறன்களைப் பெற்றுள்ளன. எனினும், நீண்ட காரணத்தடை (reasoning delays) காரணமாக இவற்றின் பயன்பாடு தற்போது வரம்புக்குட்பட்டதாக உள்ளதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளனர்.

content: A potential shift in Federal Reserve monetary policy, potentially triggered by an economic downturn in the artificial intelligence sector, could create a favorable environment for Bitcoin. content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுத் துறையில் ஏற்படும் மந்தநிலை காரணமாக Federal Reserve-இன் கொள்கையில் மாற்றம் ஏற்பட்டால், அது Bitcoin-க்கு சாதகமான சூழலை உருவாக்கக்கூடும் என்று CoinShares நிறுவனத்தின் போர்ட்ஃபோலியோ மேலாளர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இத்தகைய மேக்ரோ பொருளாதார மாற்றங்கள் Bitcoin-ஐ ஒரு பாதுகாப்பான முதலீட்டாக மாற்றக்கூடும் என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
summary: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.
content: The controversy surrounding compromised Ledger hardware wallets has reached Dubai after two owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in cryptocurrency. The victims stated they purchased their devices from an authorized Virgin Megastore location in Dubai, raising serious security concerns regarding the retail supply chain and the safety of physical crypto storage devices bought from mainstream authorized stores.
content_ta: compromising செய்யப்பட்ட Ledger ஹார்டுவேர் வாலட்கள் தொடர்பான சர்ச்சை துபாயை எட்டியுள்ளது. அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட சில்லறை விற்பனையாளரான Virgin Megastore-ல் வாங்கிய வாலட்கள் மூலம் தங்களின் cryptocurrency-களை இழந்ததாக இரண்டு உரிமையாளர்கள் புகார் அளித்துள்ளனர். இதில் மொத்தம் $604,000 இழப்பு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாகத் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் சில்லறை விநியோகச் சங்கிலி மற்றும் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்து தீவிர கவலைகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam
summary: The company said the system prevented about 91% of the attempted transfers linked to the fake Tesla livestream, with no human intervention.
content: Coinbase announced that its AI defense system successfully blocked $4.7 million from being sent to a deepfake Elon Musk scam. According to the company, the automated system prevented about 91% of attempted transfers related to a fake Tesla livestream without requiring any human intervention.
content_ta: Elon Musk-ன் டீப்ஃபேக் மோசடிக்கு அனுப்பப்படவிருந்த 4.7 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை Coinbase-ன் AI பாதுகாப்பு அமைப்பு வெற்றிகரமாகத் தடுத்ததாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. எந்தவொரு மனித தலவுமின்றி, போலி Tesla லைவ்ஸ்ட்ரீம் தொடர்பான முயற்சிகளில் சுமார் 91 சதவீதப் பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை இந்த தானியங்கி அமைப்பு தடுத்ததாக நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Lighter Reopens Withdrawals After Nonce-Reuse Error Exposes Trader API Keys
summary: Decentralized derivatives venue Lighter says deposits and withdrawals have resumed following a November 16 security incident that initially froze access. The latest.
content: Decentralized derivatives venue Lighter has resumed deposits and withdrawals following a security incident that temporarily froze user access. The platform experienced a nonce-reuse error that exposed trader API keys. Lighter confirmed that operations are now back to normal after addressing the vulnerability.
content_ta: டீசென்ட்ரலைஸ்டு டெரிவேட்டிவ்ஸ் தளமான Lighter, பாதுகாப்புப் பிரச்சனை காரணமாக தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தப்பட்டிருந்த டெபாசிட் மற்றும் வித்ட்ராவல் சேவைகளை மீண்டும் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. டிரேடர்களின் API கீகளை வெளிப்படுத்திய 'nonce-reuse' பிழை காரணமாக இந்த பாதுகாப்புச் சம்பவம் ஏற்பட்டது. இந்தச் சிக்கலைத் சரிசெய்த பிறகு செயல்பாடுகள் வழக்க நிலைக்குத் திரும்பியுள்ளதாக Lighter உறுதிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin tests $62K support – Can BTC bulls hold without Spot demand?
summary: Despite the price bounce from $62k, selling pressure has not begun to ease noticeably, as the apparent demand metric showed.
content: Bitcoin recently tested the $62,000 support level, sparking questions about whether bulls can maintain this price without significant spot demand. Although the price experienced a bounce from $62,000, market data indicates that selling pressure has not eased noticeably, suggesting ongoing caution among investors as the apparent demand metric continues to be closely monitored.
content_ta: Bitcoin சமீபத்தில் $62,000 ஆதரவு நிலையைச் சோதித்தது, இது ஸ்பாட் தேவை இல்லாமல் பம்புகள் (bulls) இந்த விலையைத் தக்கவைக்க முடியுமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது. $62,000-ல் இருந்து விலை மீண்டெழுந்த போதிலும், விற்பனை அழுத்தம் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க அளவில் குறையவில்லை என்று சந்தை தரவுகள் காட்டுகின்றன, இதனால் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தொடர்ந்து எச்சரிக்கையுடன் இருக்கின்றனர்.

Billionaire Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway has sold most of its Capital One (COF) stake in just two quarters. The conglomerate held 1,150,000 Capital One (COF) shares on September 30th, down from 7,150,000 on March 31st, reports Yahoo Finance. Berkshire cut the stake to 3,000,000 COF shares in the second quarter, then to 1,150,000 in the […]
The post Berkshire Hathaway Sells 83.9% of Stake in One US Bank in Six Months While Trimming Bank of America by $1,500,000,000 appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Billionaire Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway significantly reduced its investments in the banking sector over two quarters. The conglomerate sold the vast majority of its Capital One stake, dropping from over seven million shares down to just over one million. Additionally, Berkshire Hathaway trimmed its massive holding in Bank of America by approximately 1.5 billion dollars.
content_ta: Warren Buffett-க்கு சொந்தமான Berkshire Hathaway நிறுவனம் தனது வங்கித்துறை முதலீடுகளை கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளது. Capital One நிறுவனத்தில் தான் வைத்திருந்த பங்குகளில் பெரும்பகுதியை இந்த நிறுவனம் விற்றுள்ளது. மேலும், Bank of America நிறுவனத்திலுள்ள தனது பங்குகளில் சுமார் 1.5 பில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான பங்குகளை Berkshire Hathaway குறைத்துள்ளது.

title: Strategy stock could plunge 76% to $23, chart analyst warns
summary: Aksel Kibar, who has tracked Bitcoin’s price action since at least 2018, made the bearish call, citing a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern on MicroStrategy’s (MSTR) daily chart.
content: Chart analyst Aksel Kibar has issued a bearish warning for MicroStrategy stock, suggesting it could plunge 76% to $23. Kibar, known for tracking Bitcoin price action since at least 2018, based his projection on a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern visible on the daily chart of MSTR.
content_ta: சார்ட் அனலிஸ்ட் Aksel Kibar, MicroStrategy ஸ்டாக் 76 சதவீதம் சரிந்து $23 வரை குறையக்கூடும் என்று எச்சரித்துள்ளார். குறைந்தபட்சம் 2018 முதல் Bitcoin விலை நகர்வுகளைக் கண்காணித்து வரும் Kibar, MSTR நிறுவனத்தின் டெய்லி சார்ட்டில் உள்ள head-and-shoulders பேட்டர்னைச் சுட்டிக்காட்டி இந்த எச்சரிக்கையை விடுத்துள்ளார்.

AI-driven automation on private blockchains could revolutionize financial transactions, enhancing efficiency while maintaining compliance.

content: Hyundai Card has successfully tested AI agent commerce on JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain platform. summary:

content: A hacker linked to the Scattered Spider cybercrime group has been sentenced to six years in prison following a large-scale cryptocurrency theft involving millions of dollars. content_ta: Scattered Spider சைபர் கிரைம் கும்பலுடன் தொடர்புடைய ஒரு ஹேக்கருக்கு, மில்லியன் கணக்கில் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி திருடப்பட்ட வழக்கில் ஆறு ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த வழக்கு டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து திருட்டுகள் மீதான சட்ட நடவடிக்கைகளையும், தனிப்பட்ட சைபர் பாதுகாப்பில் உள்ள குறைபாடுகளையும் சுட்டிக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: DBS lets eligible institutions in Asia mint and redeem USDC around the clock
summary: DBS and Circle are expanding institutional access to USDC with direct minting, redemption and 24/7 dollar settlement.
content: DBS and Circle have expanded institutional access to USDC, allowing eligible institutions in Asia to mint and redeem the stablecoin around the clock. This partnership provides these financial institutions with direct minting and redemption capabilities, as well as continuous dollar settlement services to enhance operational efficiency in the region.
content_ta: DBS மற்றும் Circle நிறுவனங்கள் இணைந்து USDC-க்கான நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் அணுகலை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளன. இதன் மூலம் ஆசியாவில் உள்ள தகுதியான நிறுவனங்கள் எந்த நேரத்திலும் USDC-ஐப் பெறவும் (mint) மாற்றவும் (redeem) முடியும். இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு இப்பகுதியில் உள்ள நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்கு நேரடி பரிமாற்ற வசதிகளையும், தடையற்ற டாலர் தீர்வு சேவைகளையும் வழங்குகிறது.

summary:
Nvidia’s first report since Jensen Huang’s departure topped sales estimates, while Bitcoin gave back most of its initial gain within 35 minutes.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Nvidia reported strong sales for its first report since Jensen Huang's departure. Meanwhile, Bitcoin attempted a rally following the earnings report but quickly surrendered most of its initial gains within minutes. This failed momentum has brought the crucial $62,000 support level back into focus for market watchers.
content_ta: Jensen Huang-ன் வெளியேற்றத்திற்குப் பிறகு வெளியிடப்பட்ட முதல் அறிக்கையில் Nvidia நிறுவனம் சிறப்பான விற்பனை வளர்ச்சியைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், இந்த நிறுவனத்தின் வருவாய் அறிக்கை வெளியானதும் Bitcoin விலையை உயர்த்திய முயற்சி தோல்வியடைந்ததுடன், குறுகிய நேரத்தில் தனது ஆரம்பகட்ட லாபத்தையும் இழந்தது. இந்த விலை சரிவு காரணமாக முக்கியமான $62,000 ஆதரவு நிலை மீண்டும் சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்களின் கவனத்திற்கு வந்துள்ளது.

title: Vitalik Buterin Wants Crypto to Have Housing’s Stability, But Can Ethereum Deliver?
summary:
Vitalik Buterin wants digital assets to offer housing-like stability, but can Ethereum roadmap help ETH become a long-term investment?
The post Vitalik Buterin Wants Crypto to Have Housing’s Stability, But Can Ethereum Deliver? appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has expressed a desire for digital assets to achieve a level of stability similar to the housing market. As the crypto community discusses the Ethereum roadmap and its potential to foster long-term investments, questions remain about whether the network can successfully deliver this kind of economic security.
content_ta: Ethereum co-founder ஆன Vitalik Buterin, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் வீட்டுவசதி சந்தையைப் போன்ற ஒரு நிலைத்தன்மையை அடைய வேண்டும் என்ற தனது விருப்பத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. title: MEXC Announces Global Card Service Discontinuation
summary:
The shutdown highlights the vulnerability of crypto card services to third-party issuer changes, impacting user trust and service continuity.
The post MEXC shuts down Global Card service after third-party issuer changes appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange MEXC has announced the discontinuation of its Global Card service following changes made by its third-party issuer. This shutdown emphasizes the ongoing vulnerability and reliance that crypto card services have on external financial partners, which can impact user trust and disrupt service continuity across the platform.
content_ta: கிரப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் ஆன MEXC, தனது தேர்ட்-பார்ட்டி இஷ்யூவர் செய்த மாற்றங்களை அடுத்து, தனது Global Card சேவையை நிறுத்துவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த மூடல், கிரிப்டோ கார்டு சேவைகள் வெளிப்புற நிதி பங்காளிகளைச் சார்ந்து இருப்பதன் மூலம் எதிர்கொள்ளும் பாதிப்புகளை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது, இது பயனர் நம்பிக்கையையும் சேவையின் தொடர்ச்சியையும் பாதிக்கிறது.

title: Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Is in “Capital Preservation” Mode. What Did He Sell?
summary:
Druckenmiller's 13F shows a 94% TSMC cut and a bigger Seagate stake, yet he says he is not long equities.
The post Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Is in “Capital Preservation” Mode. What Did He Sell? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Investor Stanley Druckenmiller is currently in capital preservation mode, according to recent regulatory filings. His latest 13F filing reveals a significant 94% reduction in his TSMC holdings while increasing his stake in Seagate. Despite these adjustments, Druckenmiller noted that he is not currently long on equities.
content_ta: முதலீட்டாளர் Stanley Druckenmiller தற்போது மூலதனப் பாதுகாப்பு முறையில் உள்ளதாக சமீபத்திய ஆவணங்கள் காட்டுகின்றன. அவரது 13F தாக்கலின்படி, TSMC பங்குகளின் அளவை 94% வரை அவர் கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளார், அதே நேரத்தில் Seagate நிறுவனத்திலான தனது பங்குகளை அதிகரித்துள்ளார். இருப்பினும், தான் தற்போது பங்குகளில் நீண்ட கால முதலீடு செய்யவில்லை என்று அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: Morpho launches on OKX’s X Layer with Gauntlet USDC vaults and tokenized stock loans

title: Etherscan warns users after attempted unauthorized access to its support system
summary:

content: Blockchain analytics platform Etherscan issued a warning to users following an attempted unauthorized access incident targeting its support system. title: LMAX Group brings crypto perpetual futures to Fintake’s Helio platform
summary:
The integration of crypto perpetual futures into Helio could significantly increase market participation and risk exposure due to high leverage.

content_ta: LMAX Group நிறுவனம் crypto perpetual futures-ஐ Fintake-ன் Helio platform-ல் இணைத்துள்ளது. இந்த புதிய ஒருங்கிணைப்பு பயனர்களுக்கு கிடைக்கும் crypto நிதி தயாரிப்புகளின் அளவை விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. இருப்பினும், அதிக leverage கொண்ட இந்த perpetual futures வர்த்தகம் சந்தையில் பங்கேற்பதை அதிகரிப்பதுடன், வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு அதிகப்படியான அபாயத்தையும் ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்று சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: House Democrats investigate Commerce Secretary Lutnick over Megaspeed blacklisting delay
summary:
The investigation into Lutnick may lead to political fallout, affecting his tenure and impacting market perceptions of his future role.

title: Riff Teams Up With Griffin to Power Automated Savings Across FSCS-Protected Banks
summary:
Riff, a savings agent that moves customers’ idle cash across a panel of FSCS-protected banks to access competitive interest rates, is partnering with Griffin to build its product on regulated banking infrastructure. 
Traditionally, customers looking to make their “lazy cash” work harder have to compare rates across banks, open accounts, transfer money manually and keep monitoring rate changes. Riff aims to take that effort away by automating the process of moving customers’ cash to banks where it can earn more, and bringing it back whenever they want it.
In this partnership, Griffin will provide the embedded bank accounts behind Riff’s offering: a hub account for each customer and a pooled savings account, serving as one of the panel banks on Riff.
Alongside giving customers access to competitive interest rates, Riff can also help them make the most of FSCS protection. The Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) protects eligible deposits up to £120,000 per person, per bank, so spreading money across more than one bank can protect a larger total balance. Together, this makes Riff a new, hands-off way to manage cash where customers set their preferences once, and Riff does the comparing, moving and checking from there.
Beyond individual customers, Riff works with platforms, advisers and employers that want to offer their clients a better home for idle cash. Riff is building its product and progressing through the regulatory process. The launch with Griffin is phased and subject to regulatory approval.
Speaking on the partnership with Griffin, Oliver Butcher, CEO and co-founder at Riff  says “Savers shouldn't have to become rate-watchers to get a fair return on their cash. Riff takes that job away entirely, and building on Griffin means we can do it on infrastructure that's built for regulated money from the ground up."
He further adds “Griffin has been great. From the moment we were introduced - helpful, knowledgeable and responsive. The type of culture and output I hope my own business can mirror.”
Phoebe Wallis, Chief Revenue Officer at Griffin added, “Riff is bringing a new approach to managing idle cash, the kind of ambitious product we love backing. We’re pleased to provide the regulated banking infrastructure underneath it as the team builds.”

title: UK Wealth Managers Face Heavier Workloads Than Global Peers, Avaloq Research Reveals
summary:
UK wealth managers are managing significantly larger client books while spending more time on admin than their global peers, according to new research from Avaloq, a global leader in wealth management technology and services.
The findings reveal the scale of the pressures facing UK wealth managers – and the potential opportunities that could be unlocked – as firms pursue growth and consolidation while responding to increasingly complex client needs.
Avaloq's wealth insights 2026 research, conducted among 480 wealth management professionals and 4,256 investors globally, finds that UK wealth managers serve an average of 82 clients, compared with 57 globally. This represents a client book approximately 44% larger than the global average.
At the same time, UK wealth managers spend a third (32%) of their working time on admin, compared with 21% globally. Almost two thirds (63%) identify administrative workloads as a barrier to spending more time with clients, while 40% point to insufficient automation.
The findings come as UK wealth management firms seek to expand, both organically and through acquisitions. While consolidation offers opportunities to increase scale and reach new clients, it can also create additional operational demands as firms integrate different systems, processes and data.
Technology is not yet relieving the pressure
Despite technology being the obvious solution, many UK wealth managers believe their firm's systems fall short. Only 28% say they are satisfied with their firm's technology, while 58% believe their organisation is moving too slowly on digital transformation, compared with 50% globally.
The research also reveals significant obstacles to delivering personalised client service. Almost two thirds (63%) of UK wealth managers cite poor internal collaboration as a barrier, while 55% point to limited client data analytics and 53% report difficulties accessing client data.
Suman Rao, Managing Director for the UK and Ireland at Avaloq, says: "UK wealth managers have bright futures ahead, but our research shows that they are also under considerable pressure and not always able to fulfil their full potential. They are managing substantially larger client books than their global peers, but spending a substantial part of their working time on admin. As firms grow they need to make complexity doesn’t grow too, because more often than not this means more administrative work, which can result in less time for clients.
“Technology has a critical role to play in addressing this challenge, but our findings suggest that many firms are not yet getting the support they need from their existing systems. Wealth managers should be able to access client information easily, work effectively across their organisations and spend more of their time providing advice. Instead, too many are dealing with fragmented data, manual processes and systems that add to their workload.
"The industry is consolidating rapidly, which can compound these challenges, because acquiring scale and benefiting from scale are two different things. As firms grow, they need to ensure their technology can support larger client books without placing unnecessary additional demands on their people. The decisions firms make about their technology today will shape how effectively they can grow over the next five to ten years and beyond, so it’s vital wealth managers are supported by systems that enable them to deliver the personalised service clients expect."

title: Lianlian DigiTech and Visa Advance Trusted B2B Agentic Commerce for Small and Medium-Sized Businesses
summary:
Lianlian DigiTech and Visa, a global leader in digital payments, today announced the next phase of their collaboration to advance trusted B2B agentic commerce. The companies have completed their first live transaction in Asia Pacific through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect, using a tokenised payment credential designed specifically for an authorised AI agent. Also unveiled at the Singapore Fintech Festival, Lianlian DigiTech is also launching LianLian XCard, powered by Visa Intelligent Commerce, extending the collaboration into business spending and expense management. 
The latest transaction builds on an earlier live purchasing journey and shows how an authorised AI agent can complete a business purchase using a credential designed for agentic commerce. For small and medium-sized businesses, these capabilities offer opportunities to simplify routine purchasing and payments while retaining control over spending. Together with LianLian XCard, the developments can help businesses spend less time managing everyday transactions and more time focused on customers and growth.
From controlled purchases to agent-initiated payments
In the earlier transaction, Lianlian DigiTech’s AI agent, LoopX Pay, identified a purchasing requirement, evaluated suppliers, placed an order and completed payment within predefined spending limits and approval requirements. In the latest transaction, LianLian XWorker, an AI agent registered in the Visa Agentic Directory obtained an agent-specific tokenised payment credential through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect and completed a live office supply purchase.
The new credential adds an agent-specific payment capability to the end-to-end experience. Together with agent identification and business-defined controls, it supports transactions in which businesses can determine what an authorised agent may purchase and how payment is made.
Bringing greater control to everyday business spend
From 18 November 2026, eligible clients can apply for LianLian XCard through LianLian XWorker. Designed to help businesses manage spending across teams and projects, LianLian XCard offers tools including card limits and transaction thresholds. Customers can also link their LianLian XPay wallet to enable authorised AI agents to make payments using LianLian XCard within business-defined parameters. Selected AI-related benefits are planned for eligible customers.
“As AI agents take on a greater role in commerce, trust will be essential to helping businesses adopt these new capabilities with confidence,” said Stephen Karpin, President, Asia Pacific, Visa. “Our collaboration with Lianlian DigiTech brings together Visa's B2B payment capabilities and Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect to support secure, controlled agent-initiated payments. This creates new opportunities for small and medium-sized businesses across Asia Pacific to simplify purchasing, expand their reach and focus on growth.”
“AI is creating new opportunities for businesses around the world. As agents take on more of the work behind commerce, from evaluating options and coordinating purchases to making payments, security, trust and control must remain fundamental,” said Tim Shen, Co-President of Lianlian DigiTech. “With LianLian XCard, we are also bringing AI-powered financial capabilities and global business payments closer to companies’ everyday needs. We look forward to building on this partnership and helping more businesses embrace intelligent commerce with confidence.”
Together, the next phase of the collaboration and the launch of LianLian XCard will give businesses more ways to manage purchasing and payments as AI becomes part of everyday commercial activity. Lianlian DigiTech and Visa will continue exploring applications across procurement, supplier payments and other B2B workflows, helping businesses pursue new opportunities as intelligent commerce develops.

title: Apicunia and PayPoint Partner to Extend European Payee Verification
summary:
Apicunia has partnered with PayPoint to bring its European Verification of Payee (VoP) service to PayPoint customers, helping businesses verify beneficiary details before payments are made.
 
The partnership builds on PayPoint’s existing capabilities, including multichannel payments, Open Banking, Confirmation of Payee (CoP), and API-led platforms by adding European VoP through Apicunia’s specialist technology. The service allows customers to verify beneficiary names against account details before initiating a payment. Checking payment details earlier in the process can help businesses reduce payment errors, strengthen fraud controls and avoid the disruption of discovering a problem when a payment is ready to go.
 
While CoP supports name-checking for UK payments, VoP extends this capability to payments covered by the European scheme, enabling customers to check beneficiary details across additional markets.
 

Gary Farrow, Founder and CEO of Apicunia, said:
“We’re delighted to be partnering with PayPoint. Bringing together their payment expertise and market reach with Apicunia’s payee verification capabilities creates exciting opportunities. We look forward to collaborating to bring new services to market centred on ‘Know Your Payee’, helping businesses understand who they are paying and transacting with greater confidence.” 
Simon Coles, Managing Director at PayPoint, added: 
“Our customers need simple, reliable ways to check that payments are going to the intended recipient. Combining PayPoint’s payments expertise with Apicunia’s specialist Verification of Payee technology will help customers identify potential discrepancies earlier and make payments with greater confidence.” 
The partnership marks an important milestone in Apicunia’s work to make payee verification accessible to more businesses.
